cues: Fourteen lines, which is why your exercises call it a sonnet, but there is no regular metre and no sonnet rhyme scheme.
Instead, seven rhyming couplets: a a, b b, c c, and so on.
The couplets are the argument: pairs of lines that answer one another, until the last couplet names the idea: may our lives rhyme.
